canonical.header: Ranked by rarity against each name's own norm. Error rate not yet measured.
canonical.alertCount: {n} price {alerts} today (provisional). Design rate, averaged over sessions: at most 1 in 10 is expected to be false, if the model of each name is right.
canonical.paused: Alerts paused for small caps: scale model heavier than calibrated, as measured through yesterday's close.
canonical.empty: Nothing has crossed the line this session. That is a reading, not a forecast.

motion.live: Live: motion is a real arrival or your own hand.
motion.ambient: Ambient: pulses and breathing encode premium by speed and density, not individual trades; labelled ambient motion, not data.

seam: Bands do not connect across names: calls and puts, and bullish and bearish, are two ways to split the same dollars.
convention: on the vendor's convention (dealers long calls, short puts)
askSide: Ask side and bid side are the vendor's split of each flagged window's premium. For contract volume the vendor defines the ask side as a fill above the midpoint; it does not document the alert field. Lean is a convention: ask-side calls and bid-side puts are drawn bullish. Unsided premium is never guessed into a side.
